nodes.title: SG-8.2.2 Max-length constant, counter and over-limit block
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) already blocks blank submits but has no maximum length. The backend rejects prompts over cfg.Contribution.MaxPromptLen (default 500, counted with utf8.RuneCountInString on the trimmed prompt). Desired behavior: a shared max-length constant, a visible 'n / max' counter, an inline over-limit message, and submit blocked while over the limit. Expected result: players see the limit before the backend rejects them. Why: avoids a wasted round trip and a generic 'Could not send' error.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet is open, When the player types text, Then a counter reads 'n / 500' where n is the character count of the trimmed text
- Given the text is longer than the maximum, When the player looks at the form, Then an inline over-limit message is visible and the textarea is marked invalid
- Given the text is over the limit, When the player clicks Send, Then submitContribution is not called
- Given the text is within the limit, When the player clicks Send, Then submitContribution is called as before


## Scope
- In scope: Max-length constant in the API client module
- In scope: Counter and over-limit message in ContributionSheet
- In scope: Submit blocked while over the limit
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Quota gating
- Out of scope: Blank-text validation changes
- Preserve: Blank-text 'Enter an idea first' behavior
- Preserve: History list and submit states
- Preserve: Radix Dialog behavior


## Technical constraints
- React + TypeScript only; no new dependencies
- Constant value must match the backend default of 500
- Count Unicode characters of the trimmed text, as the backend does


## Definition of done
- All requirements delivered and their unit tests pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Counter and message are exposed to assistive tech via aria-describedby


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Shared max-length constant drives a visible n / max counter
nodes.body:
Context: client.ts exports MAX_PER_PLAYER but no length constant. Desired behavior: export MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH = 500 and render a counter beside the textarea that updates on every change. Expected result: the player always sees how much room is left. Why: the limit must be visible before it is exceeded.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet is open with empty text, Then the counter reads '0 / 500'
- Given the text 'hello', Then the counter reads '5 / 500'
- Given the text '  hi  ', Then the counter reads '2 / 500' because it counts trimmed characters
- Given the textarea, Then it is described by the counter via aria-describedby


## Scope
- In scope: MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH export
- In scope: Counter element in ContributionSheet
- Out of scope: Over-limit message
- Out of scope: Submit blocking
- Preserve: Existing aria-describedby for the blank message


## Technical constraints
- Constant lives next to MAX_PER_PLAYER in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts


## Definition of done
- Counter renders and updates; constant exported


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Over-limit text shows an inline message and blocks submit
nodes.body:
Context: handleSubmit only blocks blank text. Desired behavior: compute over-limit from trimmed character count; show an inline message, set aria-invalid, and refuse to submit. Expected result: over-limit ideas are never sent. Why: backend would reject them anyway.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given 501 characters, Then the message 'Too long: 501 / 500' is visible in a role=alert element
- Given 501 characters, When Send is clicked, Then submitContribution is not called and the text is kept
- Given 500 characters, Then no over-limit message shows and Send submits
- Given over-limit text is edited down to 500 characters, Then the message disappears


## Scope
- In scope: Over-limit message
- In scope: Guard in handleSubmit
- In scope: aria-invalid on over-limit
- Out of scope: Counter
- Out of scope: Backend validation
- Preserve: Blank message behavior
- Preserve: Textarea is not hard-truncated so the message is reachable


## Technical constraints
- Do not set the maxLength attribute, because it would make the over-limit state unreachable


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Over-limit blocks submit and shows message


## Clarifying questions
- None
